title: V8 --max-old-space-size
description: Raises the old-generation heap ceiling; the standard fix for Node out-of-memory crashes. Engine: V8/Node. Effect: heap ceiling in MB. Example: `node --max-old-space-size=4096 app.js`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: V8 --turbo-filter
description: Restricts TurboFan optimization to matching functions when hunting optimizer bugs. Engine: V8. Effect: limits optimized functions. Example: `node --turbo-filter="hot*" app.js`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: V8 --trace-turbo
description: Dumps TurboFan IR graphs so you can see exactly what the optimizer did. Engine: V8. Effect: optimizer IR tracing. Example: `node --trace-turbo --turbo-filter="f" app.js`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: V8 --jitless
description: Disables JIT entirely; the hardened mode for high-risk content processes. Engine: V8. Effect: interpreter-only execution. Example: `node --jitless app.js`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: V8 --allow-natives-syntax
description: Exposes %DebugPrint and friends for inspecting optimization and heap internals. Engine: V8. Effect: native test hooks. Example: `node --allow-natives-syntax dbg.js`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: HotSpot TieredCompilation
description: Enables C1+C2 tiered JIT, the default adaptive optimizer on modern JVMs. Engine: HotSpot. Effect: adaptive multi-tier JIT. Example: `java -XX:+TieredCompilation App`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: HotSpot CompileThreshold
description: Sets invocations before C2 compiles a method; lowering warms up faster. Engine: HotSpot. Effect: JIT trigger threshold. Example: `java -XX:CompileThreshold=1000 App`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: HotSpot MaxGCPauseMillis
description: G1’s pause-time goal; the collector trades throughput to hit it. Engine: HotSpot/G1. Effect: GC pause target. Example: `java -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 App`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: JVM -Xmx heap cap
description: Caps the Java heap; the first knob turned in every memory investigation. Engine: HotSpot. Effect: max heap size. Example: `java -Xmx4g App`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: PyPy --jit off
description: Disables the tracing JIT to compare warmup behavior or dodge JIT bugs. Engine: PyPy. Effect: disable tracing JIT. Example: `pypy --jit off script.py`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: LuaJIT -j off
description: Turns the JIT compiler off, leaving the fast interpreter for debugging. Engine: LuaJIT. Effect: disable JIT. Example: `luajit -j off app.lua`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: LuaJIT -O
description: Sets optimization level; -O3 enables the most aggressive trace optimizations. Engine: LuaJIT. Effect: optimization level. Example: `luajit -O3 app.lua`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: .NET TieredCompilation
description: Lets methods start quick-JITed and recompile optimized when hot. Engine: .NET RyuJIT. Effect: tiered JIT. Example: `COMPlus_TieredCompilation=1 dotnet app.dll`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Graal Truffle background compilation
description: Compiles Truffle ASTs in the background so startup never blocks on optimization. Engine: GraalVM. Effect: background optimizing. Example: `java -Dgraal.TruffleBackgroundCompilation=true App`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Node --stack-size
description: Raises the stack limit for deep recursion before RangeError strikes. Engine: V8/Node. Effect: stack size in KB. Example: `node --stack-size=2000 deep.js`.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
